provenance.width_nm: assumed: Lightmatter render 400 x 200 nm (SMTAI, 01 section 2.1); BU 45CLO rib 410 nm
provenance.film_nm: printed for 45SPCLO (160 nm, GF-IMAPS); 200 nm is the D21 alternative
provenance.slab_nm: assumed: partial-etch depth not public (01 section 4.2); slab/film ~0.38-0.40, cf. 90/220
provenance.r_ref_um: the modes artefact's r_ref (self-consistent radius for the printed 1.8 THz design FSR) when it exists, else the same self-consistency computed here (07 P1-6)

doping.provenance: assumed. No 45SPCLO or Lightmatter doping is public. Body doping inside the 5e17-3e18 cm^-3 range quoted in docs/research (05 C7c 5e17; 03 sections 5.1/6.2 1e17-1e18 and 3e18; 06 V15 1-3e18). Lateral: 2e18 (mid-range; no level up to 5e18 reaches CAL-5 with fill <= 1, see reports.doping_sweep). L-shape: the symmetric level at which CAL-5 needs fill = 0.85 (doping.selection). Implant offsets and contact levels are generic MRM values (assumed, swept in the Jacobian).

selection.rule: symmetric N at which the CAL-5 endpoint fill = 0.85 (log-linear interpolation)

units.dneff: 1 (relative to 0 V, bent mode at r_ref)

overlap.weight: index weight c eps0 n (1+x/R)^2 |E|^2 / P (03 verification log: not the power fraction); x > 0 is the outer side (n side)
overlap.mode_solver: femwell order 2, conformal bend, core res 0.01 um

depletion_check.note: 05 C7c reported 5-8 % (DEVSIM below the abrupt formula) with mixed permittivities; here both use 11.7 eps0; the edges are the half-doping points of the simulated carriers on a mid-film cut

H86_via_R1.basis: R1 with dn_eff/dT from the solver, dlambda/dT = 85.9 pm/K

FSR_window_B_R7.5um.basis: FSR 1.8 THz (1.72-1.88) at R = 7.5 um pinned

FSR_window_A_R7.5um.basis: FSR 1.4 THz (1.32-1.48) at R = 7.5 um pinned

FSR_stress_G25_cluster_R7.5um.basis: FSR 1.53 THz (1.52-1.54) at R = 7.5 um pinned

FSR_stress_PDK_size_R7.5um.basis: FSR 1.6 THz (1.58-1.63) at R = 7.5 um pinned

cal5.nominal_fill_note: H_solver row; fill scales as n_g. Without the self-heating relief correction (the G25 measurement power is not published); see selfheat_relief.

selfheat_relief.assumptions: K_SH 405 pm/mW absorbed (03 table, range 160-1400), critical coupling at 0 V, Q_i 7700 at 0 V, read-out at the transmission dip; eta0 either the FCA share only or 0.85 (07 D1)

eo_bandwidth.method: single-pole RC (R_s + R_src) C_j x exact TCMT optical response (03 section 5.6, Sacher & Poon 2008 pole pair), critical coupling, q from this LUT

junction_rc_only.note: r_s' c' is independent of fill and length (ideal driver, no pads)

measured_ratio_2v_over_1v.source: LM-P Fig. 1(f) legend 31.8 / 35.4 GHz (03 verification log #16)

loss_budget.note: eta = (f alpha_FCA + alpha_other_abs)/alpha_i. alpha_scatter taken as the printed GF rib loss 0.73 dB/cm (it includes everything passive); alpha_rad from the modes artefact (not included). eta_min assumes the unexplained remainder does not heat; eta_max that it all heats.

doping_sweep.note: consistent = fill <= 1 (CAL-5 reachable with this junction) and f alpha_FCA(0 V) <= alpha_i at Q_i = 7000; DEVSIM scale 2.828, mode res 0.016 um

jacobian.note: central differences (grading: forward step from the nominal 2 nm; outer_side: the difference 'p outside' minus 'n outside' (the nominal), not a derivative); densities per decade (log10); geometry steps re-solve the mode and n_g; DEVSIM scale 2.828, mode res 0.016 um; eff_avg is at fill 1 with the perturbed n_g

voltage_shift_model.note: runtime temperature axis (plant_electrical handoff): look up the 300 K table at V + dV_bi/dT (T - T_ref); compared here with the DEVSIM solution at 340 K referenced to the cold 0 V state (carriers only)

temperature_sensitivity.note: n_i(T), V_t(T), Arora mu(T) in DEVSIM; plasma per-carrier factors from mrm.materials.plasma_temperature_factor (assumed); optical mode held at 300 K
